items.title: Should You Buy CVS Stock For The Margin Aetna Is Rebuilding?

items.title: The One Cost Line UnitedHealth Stock Has Not Caught Up To Yet
items.summary: UnitedHealth's repair job is going to plan almost everywhere. The exception is the cost of its commercial health plans, where medical costs are running modestly above the 11% the company had been expecting. Medicare costs are coming in below what it planned for 2026, and Medicaid cost trend is in line, though management expects Medicaid margins to stay pressured for 2026. That cost divergence is what a holder should watch.
